collections.name: support_tickets
collections.description: Core ticket records for the POV, covering both historical resolved tickets used for similarity retrieval/training context and incoming/unresolved tickets shown in the queue and dashboard.

ticket_id.description: Source/business identifier for the ticket in the representative imported dataset.

channel.description: Ticket source channel, included because current state explicitly mentions email/chat/phone.

text_combined.description: Pre-concatenated subject + description used as the primary text payload for search/vectorization and triage inference.

status.description: POV-level ticket lifecycle state to support queue filtering and resolved-ticket reporting. Kept simple because actual helpdesk workflow is out of scope.

resolved_at.description: Needed to calculate resolution time for resolved tickets when present in the representative historical slice.

priority.description: Actual/legacy manually set priority from imported historical data or evaluator-entered outcome.

routing_team_id.description: Actual assigned/resolved team when known from historical data.

advisory_only.description: Preserves FR-11 ambiguity rather than resolving it in the schema.

resolution_summary.description: Agent-written resolution summary, present for historical resolved tickets and shown as context for similar tickets.

triage.description: Optional POV triage metadata; lightweight because full workflow integration is out of scope.

embedding.description: Vector embedding of text_combined for similarity retrieval over historical tickets.

ingest_batch_id.description: Identifier for the imported representative dataset batch.

embedding_vs_references.rationale: Suggestion objects are embedded because they are always accessed with the ticket when an agent opens or triages it. Team is referenced to avoid repeating mutable team metadata across many tickets while allowing dashboard joins/grouping by stable team ids.

indexes.name: ux_ticket_id
indexes.reason: Supports idempotent historical import and direct ticket lookup by business identifier in the queue/open-ticket workflow.

indexes.name: queue_status_createdAt
indexes.reason: Supports agent queue views of incoming/open tickets sorted by newest/oldest for J-1 and FR-6 context.

indexes.name: dashboard_productLine_createdAt
indexes.reason: Supports live aggregations/filtering for ticket volume by product line over time in FR-7/UC-4.

indexes.name: dashboard_priority_createdAt
indexes.reason: Supports live aggregations/filtering for ticket volume by priority over time in FR-7/UC-4.

indexes.name: dashboard_team_resolvedAt
indexes.reason: Supports average resolution time by team calculations over resolved tickets for FR-8/UC-4.

indexes.name: resolved_lookup
indexes.reason: Supports filtering historical resolved tickets for retrieval context and dashboard metrics.

indexes.name: ticket_text_search
indexes.reason: Supports text-based exploration/debugging of ticket content and can complement triage investigation over subject/description/resolution text; justified because ticket text is central to UC-1/UC-2/AI-1 and support users may inspect content-driven results in the POV.

indexes.name: ticket_similarity_vector
indexes.reason: Supports instant retrieval of 3-4 similar resolved historical tickets from ticket text at scale for UC-3, AI-2, MO-1, MO-2, SC-2, and SC-3.

collections.name: support_teams
collections.description: Reference data for routing destinations / operational teams used in ticket suggestions and dashboard grouping.

embedding_vs_references.rationale: Small, reusable reference collection avoids duplicating team labels across many ticket documents and supports consistent routing suggestion output and dashboard grouping.

indexes.name: ux_team_code
indexes.reason: Supports stable lookup of routing destinations during seed import and suggestion generation.

indexes.name: ux_team_name
indexes.reason: Supports admin/config lookups and dashboard label resolution by human-readable team name.
